newsitem.title: UK: UK house prices seen up four pct in 1997 - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK house prices seen up four pct in 1997 - survey.

text.p: British house prices are expected to rise about four percent in 1997, adding to large gains made last year, according to a survey of estate agents by Birmingham Midshires building society on Tuesday.

It said estate agents polled in its Birmingham Midshires/ICM Housing Monitor reported house prices rose by 10 percent over the past year and that 83 percent, or four out of five agents, believed prices would rise by around 4.24 percent during 1997.

"The majority (79 percent) remain confident that the housing market is improving, with half the estate agents surveyed now feeling the recovery is genuine, especially in London and the South East where confidence is being fuelled by increasing sales," the report said.
